g1_dossier.title: Нижнедвинская коридорная ячейка

limitations: Coordinates define the technical 32 km cell only; they are not a medieval boundary.

activation_reasons: source-backed northern tribute network at basin scale
required connection between approved east and north corridor cells
activation_basis.reconstruction_method: Retain as a broad lower-Dvina transit cell. Do not infer an exact river line, settlement, landing, ethnic composition, direct administration or medieval boundary.
limitations: No approved historical or archaeological anchor lies in the cell.
GSHHS land/water proxy omits internal river water at this resolution.

geographic_profile.summary: Broad lower-Northern-Dvina transit cell immediately upstream of the approved river-mouth cell. Exact 1230 channel, banks and floodplain geometry are unknown.
geographic_profile.proxy_limitation: GSHHS shoreline proxy omits internal river water at this resolution; no medieval water fraction is inferred.

hydrology_profile.known: approved lower Northern Dvina corridor at macro scale

supported: tribute/resource movement at broad regional scale
reconstructed: seasonal fishing/hunting/foraging use as regional typology

ethnocultural_profile.rule: No ethnic percentages or automatic identity assignment. Character identity requires separate grounded materialization.

transport_profile.primary: lower Dvina river corridor from east neighbour to north neighbour

uncertainties: east boundary entry until neighbour is processed

access_rules: winter use only when ice conditions permit
g5_anchor_rules: materialize exact channel only from current environmental state

g4_locations.name: Полоса мелей и боковых течений

access_rules: requires local observation or grounded guide knowledge
g5_anchor_rules: select exact hazard type only from current state or grounded local knowledge

access_rules: exists only when ice state is safe
must not be assumed from calendar alone
g5_anchor_rules: materialize only after weather and ice-state procedure approves
g4_locations.reconstruction_method: seasonal route category, not fixed path

g4_locations.name: Сезонно затапливаемая пойма
access_rules: access depends on water and freeze state
g5_anchor_rules: do not materialize exact flood edge as permanent

g4_locations.name: Пойменная сухая грива: зона-кандидат
g4_locations.function: possible locally raised dry ground within the floodplain complex
access_rules: existence and usability require scene-level grounding
g5_anchor_rules: may materialize only if environmental procedure establishes suitable ground
must not automatically become a camp or settlement

g4_locations.name: Береговой выход: зона-кандидат
g4_locations.function: possible temporary transition between boat travel and dry ground
access_rules: requires suitable bank, water level and current state
g5_anchor_rules: do not create a permanent landing, pier or settlement without evidence

g4_locations.name: Влажный лесной промысловый участок
g4_locations.function: possible low-intensity seasonal hunting, gathering or wood-resource area
seasonal_use: resource use only when actor and season support it
g5_anchor_rules: materialize activity only with causal actor/event basis
do not create a permanent camp by default

g4_locations.name: Зона трудной ориентировки
g4_locations.function: represents difficult movement away from the river corridor
access_rules: requires route knowledge, landmarks or navigation procedure
g5_anchor_rules: exact obstacles and landmarks are scene-level outputs
